title: Orthodontist consultation
what: The orthodontist examines your teeth and bite. They tell you whether straightening is needed and by what method.
why: For crooked teeth, a wrong bite, crowding or gaps between teeth - for children and adults.
tell_doctor: What bothers you: looks, chewing, speech, breathing
If there have been injuries to the teeth or jaw
Habits: thumb sucking, mouth breathing, teeth grinding
For a child: when the teeth started to change

prepare.title: Teeth
prepare.text: Brush your teeth before the visit.

prepare.title: Scans
prepare.text: If you have scans of your teeth, bring them. Sometimes scans are taken on the day of the visit.

bring: Scans of your teeth, if you have them
A list of questions for the doctor
steps: The doctor asks what bothers you
May take photos of your face and teeth
Orders scans or takes impressions, if needed
Explains the treatment options and timing
feel: An impression can make you gag - breathe through your nose
after: The doctor gives a treatment plan after the scans
You can take time to think
Ask questions about timing and care

faq.q: From what age should we see an orthodontist?
faq.a: A first check is usually advised for children at the start of tooth change. For adults, at any age.
Yes, usually. Treatment may take longer than for children.

reminders.text: Orthodontist consultation tomorrow. Brush your teeth and take your scans, if you have them.
